title: Despite, however, so that, in order to
summary: Nối ý tương phản (although, despite, in spite of, however) và mục đích (to, in order to, so that).

dialogue.en: [[Despite]] the rain, we went to the beach.
dialogue.vi: Dù trời mưa, bọn mình vẫn đi biển.
Ừ. Tuy nhiên, bọn mình không bơi.

dialogue.en: We went [[in order to]] take photos of the storm.
dialogue.vi: Bọn mình đi để chụp ảnh cơn bão.

dialogue.en: Next time, bring a bag [[so that]] your camera stays dry!
dialogue.vi: Lần sau mang theo túi để máy ảnh không bị ướt nhé!

sections.heading: Although + câu, despite + danh từ / V-ing
sections.rule: **although / even though + câu** (S + V). **despite / in spite of + danh từ hoặc V-ing** (không có câu).

formula.text: [Despite / In spite of] + danh từ / V-ing, …

body: Người Việt hay viết *Despite it rained*. Sai, vì sau despite không có câu. Đổi thành *Despite the rain* hoặc *Although it rained*.

examples.en: [[Although]] it was late, we kept working.
examples.vi: Dù đã muộn, chúng tôi vẫn làm tiếp.

examples.en: [[Despite]] the traffic, we arrived on time.
examples.vi: Dù kẹt xe, chúng tôi vẫn đến đúng giờ.

examples.en: [[In spite of]] feeling sick, she went to work.
examples.vi: Dù thấy mệt, cô ấy vẫn đi làm.

check.prompt: ___ the bad weather, the flight left on time.
check.explain: Theo sau là danh từ → Despite.

sections.heading: However: nối hai câu
sections.rule: **however** = tuy nhiên. Đứng **đầu câu thứ hai**, sau dấu chấm hoặc chấm phẩy, theo sau là **dấu phẩy**.

examples.en: The hotel was cheap. [[However]], it was very clean.
examples.vi: Khách sạn rẻ. Tuy nhiên, nó rất sạch.
examples.why: However mở đầu câu thứ hai.

examples.en: I studied hard; [[however]], I failed the test.
examples.vi: Tôi học chăm; tuy nhiên tôi vẫn trượt.

options: It was raining. However, we went out.
It was raining, however we went out.
check.explain: However đầu câu mới, sau nó có dấu phẩy.

sections.heading: To, in order to, so that
sections.rule: Mục đích: **to / in order to + V**; hoặc **so that + S + can / could / will / would + V** (thường khi chủ ngữ khác nhau).
body: *In order to* trang trọng hơn *to*. Phủ định: **so as not to + V** hoặc **so that… won't / wouldn't**.

examples.en: I'm saving money [[to buy]] a car.
examples.vi: Tôi đang tiết kiệm để mua ô tô.

examples.en: She left early [[in order to]] catch the train.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đi sớm để kịp tàu.

examples.en: I'll speak slowly [[so that]] everyone can understand.
examples.vi: Tôi sẽ nói chậm để mọi người hiểu được.
examples.why: Chủ ngữ khác (everyone) → so that + can.

check.prompt: He wrote it down ___ he wouldn't forget.
check.explain: Theo sau là câu (he wouldn't forget) → so that.

mistakes.wrong: Despite it rained, we went out.
mistakes.right: Although it rained, we went out.
mistakes.why: Sau despite không có câu → although (hoặc Despite the rain).

mistakes.wrong: Although the rain, we went out.
mistakes.right: Despite the rain, we went out.

mistakes.wrong: It was cheap, however it was good.
mistakes.right: It was cheap. However, it was good.

mistakes.wrong: I went to the shop for buy milk.
mistakes.right: I went to the shop to buy milk.
mistakes.why: Mục đích → to + V, không dùng for + V.

mistakes.wrong: I study hard so that pass the exam.
mistakes.right: I study hard so that I can pass the exam.
mistakes.why: So that + chủ ngữ + can + V.

exercises.prompt: ___ she was tired, she finished the report.
In spite of ___ hard, he didn't pass.
I turned off my phone ___ I could concentrate.
exercises.explain: Theo sau là câu → so that.

options: Despite the noise, I slept well.
Despite it was noisy, I slept well.

exercises.prompt: We went to the market ___ buy some fruit.
answers: to
in order to

exercises.prompt: ___ the high price, the tickets sold out quickly.
answers: Despite
In spite of
exercises.explain: Despite / in spite of + danh từ.

exercises.prompt: The food was great. ___, the service was slow.
answers: However

exercises.prompt: She whispered so that the baby ___ wake up.
answers: wouldn't
would not
won't
will not

exercises.prompt: ___ though he's rich, he lives simply.
answers: Even

exercises.vi: Dù trời mưa, trận đấu vẫn tiếp tục.
alternatives: The match continued despite the rain.

exercises.vi: Tôi dậy sớm để tập thể dục.

exercises.sentence: Despite he was ill, he went to school.
answers: Although he was ill, he went to school.

exercises.sentence: I'm learning English for get a better job.
answers: I'm learning English to get a better job.

exercises.sentence: However the test was hard, I passed.
answers: Although the test was hard, I passed.
exercises.explain: Nối hai vế trong một câu → although; however chỉ mở đầu câu mới.

exercises.vi: Dù rất mệt, cô ấy vẫn nấu bữa tối.
